Name: Sophia Rewritten
Author: degradingwindow1
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#d5a6bd][size=5][b]
[u]>Content[/u][/b][/size][/color][/font]
Features a redo of a lot of Sophia's original heart events, giving players a fresh experience while still maintaining the things that made Sophia such a great character in the first place. 
This mod also adds 2 new heart events that are made to develop on Sophia's character Post 8-Heart Event 
Trigger Conditions for The Events:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Special Order Event: Complete the new Special Order that Sophia can post during fall after watching her 8-heart event. After reading the mail she sends you go to the vineyard on a sunny day between 6:00AM and 3:00PM.
[*]Realization Event: Enter the farmhouse between 3:00PM and 7:00PM while being married to Sophia and having 1 kid.
[/list][/spoiler]

[color=#ffe599][size=3][b][u]Multiplayer[/u][/b][/size][/color]
It is recommended that all players have this mod installed as there are a few aspects that could mess up gameplay for players without the mod, not necessarily something game breaking but a few bugs and glitches would be expected. The length of the events in this mod is also slightly longer than the original so make sure you have time to spare before going into one of them.

[color=#ffe599][size=3][b][u]Age Rating[/u][/b][/size][/color]
This mod doesn't have anything that crosses into NSFW territory or the sorts. But expect a slightly deeper exploration of grief and what it means to lose a loved one like in the original heart events.
[b]
[i][color=#ff0000]*This mod is not made with the intention to be a "better version" or a "replacement" of Sophia's original heart events. It is just a different take on her story.[/color][/i]
[color=#b6d7a8]
[u][font=Trebuchet MS]
[/font][/u][/color][/b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][u][b]>How to Download/Uninstall/Update[/b][/u][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Arial][b][u][size=3]Installation:[/size][/u][/b]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Make sure you have all the required dependencies for this mod[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial]Download the zip of the mod at Files, it's called [CP] Sophia Rewritten[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Locate the /Mods folder in your Stardew Valley Folder[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Unzip the mod [/font]
[*][font=Arial]Open StardewModdingAPI or whichever method of running modded Stardew Valley you use[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Enjoy![/font]
[/list][b][u][font=Arial][size=3]Uninstallation:[/size][/font][/u][/b][list=1]
[*][font=Arial]Locate the /Mods folder in your Stardew Valley Folder[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Uninstall the folder called '[CP] Sophia Rewritten' (You might encounter some errors with certain items that are from the mod if you delete it, just put them in the trash and you'll be alright)[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Open StardewModdingAPI or whichever method of running modded Stardew Valley you use[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Enjoy![/font]
[/list][u][b][font=Arial][size=3]Updating:
[/size][/font][/b][/u][list=1]

[/list]
